brief: Propose one fix for the duplicate invoice on retry. Each worker proposes alone first, then we compare.

p-timeout.body: Make request_id once, before the retry loop, and send the same one on every attempt.

p-fixtures.body: Keep the loop, but build request_id from the invoice number, so every retry matches.

p-reviewer.body: Move retries into the API client and send an idempotency key header.

c-reviewer.body: An ID built from the invoice number blocks a deliberate resubmit after a correction.

c-fixtures.body: Agreed. Timeout's change is the smallest: one line moves out of the loop.

decision.body: Decision: Timeout's proposal. It is the smallest change, and the new test checks one request_id across retries.
